notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Cathodion that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {1}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
